gen.title: From revision to a new constitution
gen.orderNote: Follows the order taught on the page from convening to debate.

steps.label: Convention convenes in Philadelphia
steps.quote: The Federal Convention convened in the State House (Independence Hall) in Philadelphia on May 14, 1787, to revise the Articles of Confederation

steps.label: Delegates wait for quorum
steps.quote: the members adjourned from day to day until a quorum of seven states was obtained on May 25

steps.label: Delegates choose new frame of government
steps.quote: rather than amend the existing Articles, the Convention would draft an entirely new frame of government

steps.label: Summer of closed debate and redrafting
steps.quote: All through the summer, in closed sessions, the delegates debated, and redrafted the articles of the new Constitution

steps.label: Debate over central power and representation
steps.quote: Among the chief points at issue were how much power to allow the central government
